material: CeIn3, simple cubic (Pm-3m), a = 4.689 A; antiferromagnetic below T_N = 10 K with propagation vector R = (1/2,1/2,1/2); Ce3+ crystal-field ground state Gamma7 doublet (Gamma8 quartet about 12 meV higher)

experiment.instrument: CNCS time-of-flight spectrometer (SNS), co-aligned single crystals, [1,-1,0] vertical, T = 1.8 K
experiment.chi2_definition: Archived chi''(Q,E): intensities corrected for absorption, put on an absolute scale with incoherent scattering, background-subtracted, divided by the Bose factor and by the Ce3+ magnetic form factor, and corrected for kf/ki. Background subtraction leaves negative values in places.

high_energy.binning: paths R-Gamma, Gamma-X, X-M, M-Gamma; bins of +-0.0125 r.l.u. along the path; intensity integrated within +-0.17 r.l.u. along the two directions perpendicular to Gamma-X and X-M and within +-0.09 r.l.u. perpendicular to R-Gamma and M-Gamma (authors' Methods)

high_resolution.binning: lines through R along R-Gamma, R-X and R-M; bins of +-0.01 r.l.u. along the line; authors' Methods: "intensity was integrated within a distance of 0.08 r.l.u. along the two reciprocal space directions perpendicular to the reduced momentum transfer q. For the cuts in the lower panels, intensity was integrated over energies +-0.1 meV"

coordinates.rlu: momenta in reciprocal-lattice units, 1 r.l.u. = 2 pi / a; reduced wave vectors q = (h,k,l)
coordinates.path_coordinate_s: distance along R-Gamma-X-M-Gamma in r.l.u.: R = (1/2,1/2,1/2) at s = 0, Gamma at sqrt(3)/2, X = (1/2,0,0) at sqrt(3)/2 + 1/2, M = (1/2,1/2,0) at sqrt(3)/2 + 1, Gamma at sqrt(3)/2 + 1 + sqrt(1/2). On the R-Gamma file, s < 0 lies beyond R on the same (1,1,1) line. Each he_spectrum result gives s and the bin centre q.
coordinates.high_resolution_q: signed distance from R in r.l.u. along the line: RG towards (0,0,0) for q > 0 (direction (-1,-1,-1)/sqrt3), RX towards (1/2,0,0) (direction (0,-1,-1)/sqrt2), RM towards (1/2,1/2,0) (direction (0,0,-1))

he_spectrum.returns: one constant-Q energy spectrum of the 12-meV data: its path coordinate s, bin centre q, energies and chi'' (null where not measured)

hr_spectrum.returns: one constant-q energy spectrum of the high-resolution data along R-Gamma or R-X

hr_cut.returns: a high-resolution constant-energy cut (E +- 0.1 meV) along the line, with error bars

band_structure.returns: the archived band structure of the authors' periodic Anderson model along R-Gamma-X-M-Gamma

not_served: The high-resolution R-M map, the R-M constant-energy cuts and the Q-integrated chi'' are withheld for grading. The authors' theory files are not served.

rm_map.description: high-resolution chi''(q,E) along R-M: rows = q_rlu (bins of +-0.01 r.l.u.), columns = energies_meV (bins of +-0.025 meV); binning and resolution as for the other high-resolution data. Pixels at E <= 0.25 meV and pixels outside the measured range are not graded.

rm_cut_1p4meV.description: high-resolution constant-energy cut along R-M at E = 1.4 +- 0.1 meV (bins of +-0.005 r.l.u. along the line)

integrated_chi.description: chi''(Q,E) integrated over the magnon energies, binned like the 12-meV data at these path coordinates
